articles.title: From seed to fruit: How to grow papaya successfully on your balcony
articles.description: A papaya tree laden with golden fruit on your balcony sounds like a dream, but it is closer to reality than most people think. Papaya is one of the fastest-growing fruit plants, and a dwarf variety in a large pot can give you homegrown fruit within a year, as long as it gets plenty of sun, warmth and room for its roots. Here is a simple five-step guide to growing papaya on a balcony, from the first seed to the first harvest.

articles.title: Soni Razdan Clarifies 'Anti-National' Remark On Diwali Firecrackers: Don't Twist Simple Message
articles.description: Soni Razdan has clarified her remarks calling bursting firecrackers "anti-national" in a post ahead of the Diwali celebrations. The veteran actress stressed that her comments were about air pollution and public health, not religious beliefs or sentiments.

articles.title: 'RIP My Ears': Smartwatch Sounds Health Alarm During Godzilla Minus Zero Screening
articles.description: Godzilla Minus Zero is already making waves for its thunderous sound effects, with one moviegoer's smartwatch repeatedly warning him about dangerously loud noise levels during an IMAX screening.
